summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-22 08:39 Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh found no newly verified material AI-specific employment or payroll evidence changing Career Radar. BLS November 2026 Career Outlook article combines 2025-2035 projected occupational openings with AI exposure categories, explicitly stating exposure is not employment impact; projections are not observed job loss. ILO November 18 Vietnam event reports policy discussion rather than measured employment effects. OECD November 17 work-organisation study was previously submitted and rejected and is not duplicated. Older BLS payroll, OECD, ILO, and IMF evidence is not re-ingested; job postings, observed payroll, forecasts, exposure, adoption and causal attribution remain distinct.
